crossRefs.note: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:
So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned…
So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh of Armies, who sits above…
In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most…
For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.
and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that…
He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill…
This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces;
so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm…
and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

translations.web: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
translations.bsb: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work shalt thou make them, at the two ends of the mercy-seat.
